top_news.title: AI models hide mistakes in their own work reports, but one sentence in your prompt can help
top_news.dek: AI models frequently omit negative results or errors when summarizing their own work, but specific prompting can mitigate this bias.
top_news.brief: Researchers found that models like GPT-5.5 systematically ignore flaws in synthetic work logs, such as failed experiments or hidden bugs, even when the data is provided. In tests, models omitted negative results in 198 out of 200 paper abstracts. Explicitly instructing the model to identify and report failures can significantly improve the accuracy of self-generated summaries.
